launches.title: Andco: Agentic case workups for personal injury law firms.
launches.tagline: We get personal injury law firms medical, police, and insurance documents - fast and without overhead.
launches.body:
**TLDR:** Andco's AI agents run the entire pre-litigation workup for personal injury firms across every channel they use: fax, email, mail, web, SMS, and voice - so they can scale their firm without overhead.

**The first 24 hours of a case, with Andco**

The moment a PI firm signs a new client, a race starts. Police reports need to be pulled, insurers need to be called, medical providers need to be faxed (yes, still faxed). Our agents go off across all channels in parallel: requesting the police report, opening claims with carriers like Geico and Progressive, identifying UM/UIM coverage, engaging adjusters, requesting records and bills from every treating provider, and running follow-up cadences until everything lands. Roughly 8 hours of legal staff work, done before anyone at the firm sits down at their desk.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100597&key=user_uploads/1126674/72f429e1-75ec-45b9-8481-5fac0d0dce5a)

**The Problem**

Personal injury is a $50B+ industry, and firms live or die on pre-litigation workup speed. The problem: every case requires chasing dozens of documents from police departments, insurance carriers, and medical providers — most of whom still run on fax, mail, and phone. Firms have two options today

1. Hire armies of legal staff + paralegals (expensive, high turnover, caps your caseload)
2. Outsource to point-solution retrieval vendors (slow, opaque, expensive per-request)

Legal tech built for this has historically been document and case management systems — great for storing things, terrible at actually doing the work. Meanwhile AI tooling in PI has mostly focused on downstream workflows like medical chronologies and demand drafting, which still depend on someone else getting the case context in first.

**The Solution**

Andco runs the pre-lit workup end-to-end. We're the system that actually does the work of getting the context. Our agents operate across fax, email, mail, web, SMS, and voice - the same channels your legal staff uses, plus a few they can't scale on. We're live with PI firms across the US and are exploring pilots with the world's largest injury law firms.

Early results:

• 8 hours saved in the first 24 hours of a case

• 24+ hours saved between intake and demand

**About Us**

We're a team of repeat founders, ex-lawyers, and builders.

**Ryan Xue (CEO)** — previously founded Layup (W23, exited to Whatfix). Before that: Origin, McKinsey, Google.

**David Lee (CTO)** — 2x founder/CTO. Previously NoxuData and Seek.

**Mike Lemm (COO)** — Layup co-founder (W23, exited to Whatfix). Formerly attorney at Kirkland & Ellis, Harvard Law.

\
**Our Ask**

We publicly launched in March and are scaling as fast as humanly possible. We’re already live with many high volume firms across the country - handling hundreds of cases and thousands of requests each month. We can serve law firms in all 50 states.\
\
If you’re a personal injury law firm that is struggling to scale your prelit process, we’d love to hear from you. First case is on us! 

Drop us a note at [founders@useandco.com](mailto:founders@useandco.com). Site: [useandco.com](http://useandco.com)

Thanks for your support!

[@Ryan Xue](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1126674) , [@Michael Lemm](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1161905) , and [@David Lee](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1305066)

launches.title: Layup: Guide your users. Right in your product. Entirely self serve!
launches.tagline: Layup is AI that onboards and guides any user directly in your product.
launches.body:
After tons of feedback from early customers (thank you YC community for helping us break stuff!), we’re proud to share that Layup is now fully self-serve with our new point-and-click guide builder.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TqtS3ET8KmY

This is a big moment for the digital adoption space: teams can now launch in-product onboarding and guidance in _minutes_, without waiting on engineering or dragging out implementation cycles. We believe every product deserves a second cursor guiding users—and now, anyone can set it up instantly.

**Here’s what’s new (and included in every plan)**:\
✅ **Brand new point-and-click editor**: just click around your product, and we generate the in-product guide, including text for each step.\
✅ **Fully redesigned UX**: faster, smoother, simpler.\
✅ **Built-in onboarding + feature announcements** to show users what you ship.\
✅ **Dynamic guidance**: Layup guides users when they get stuck, directly in your product—no help center required.\
✅ **Flow validation + retraining**: we auto-check and fix broken flows.\
✅ **Knowledge fallback**: if a flow doesn’t exist, we harvest from your product and docs to guide users.

**What we’ve learned optimizing Layup to be self-serve**. A few lessons that might resonate if you’re working in onboarding, product education, or support:\
– Onboarding isn’t a one-time problem; it’s an ongoing infrastructure challenge. Your UI changes weekly, and your onboarding needs to evolve with it.\
– Nobody wants to “design a flow” or tag individual elements to make one: they want to point, click, and have it just work—so we built exactly that.\
– The most effective guides don’t live in a help center or static documentation—they live interactively inside your product, appearing exactly when users need them.\
– The best support content isn’t built manually; it’s harvested from your product and docs, so we built a fallback system that does just that.

Layup reflects these learnings—and we’re still in builder mode.

**Why this matters**\
If you’ve tried using a DAP (Pendo, WalkMe, Appcues, etc.), you know the pain: incredibly difficult to set up, flows break, users ignore them, and maintaining them becomes a second job.

With Layup, you can now:\
✨ **Build everything yourself in minutes**.\
✨ **Keep your guides alive even when your product changes**.\
✨ **Help users even when there isn’t a pre-recorded guide.**

We’re excited to get Layup into more products, making onboarding effortless and guidance instant. If you want to transform how your product guides and supports users, let’s chat—we’d love to get you started with Layup today. We offer a 7-day free trial so you can see the impact for yourself.\
\
Talk to us here! [**https://cal.com/team/layup/founders**](https://cal.com/team/layup/founders)

launches.title: Layup: Guide every user, anywhere in your product
launches.tagline: The second cursor that onboards, activates, and guides users through your product
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Layup helps guide users anywhere in your product. Our second cursor appears directly in your UI to walk users through step-by-step.

You invested in building the features—now guide every user through how to use them.\
\
**Update:** When we first launched two months ago, demand for our AI-driven second cursor was so overwhelming that we served everyone we could and then essentially went back into stealth mode to scale our infrastructure. Now, we're relaunching with a slew of new features and upgrades—ultra-fast latency, docs referencing, a new, beautiful widget, and \*\*dynamic conversational guides\*\*—making Layup smoother, faster, and more powerful than ever.

Anyone launching a product can now effortlessly create and maintain in-product tutorials, onboarding guides, and feature announcements with literally 0 overhead.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88104&key=user_uploads/1126674/f10f7879-95ac-4b39-b80f-ca7d78b16a66)

\
**The Problem**\
Even products with great UI can fall short if users don’t know how to find or use new or complex features.\
Traditional onboarding flows and user adoption tools—like rigid product tours or static help center articles—often fail to engage users or break when your UI changes. It’s an endless cycle of re-tagging and updating that exhausts product, growth, and support teams.\
\
**Our Solution**\
Layup embeds a **second cursor** that guides your users in real time:

1. **One Line of Code**: Invite Layup as a user and drop a snippet to overlay our widget in your UI.
2. **Advanced Knowledge Base Referencing**: Instantly surface relevant docs and FAQs in every step of a guidance flow.
3. **Dynamic Conversations & Guides**: The second cursor and conversation overlay automatically adapt as your UI evolves—no re-tagging required.
4. **New, Beautiful Widget**: Keep users engaged with a modern, intuitive design that’s integrated seamlessly into your product.

\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OkEXwpKvpv0>\
\
**Use Cases**

* **In-product guidance:** Provide instant, hands-on help that points users exactly where they need to click.
* **Onboarding & activation**: Reduce the learning curve (and time to value) by visually guiding new users through each step.
* **Feature discovery**: Turn passive observers into power users by highlighting new releases in real time.

**How It Works**

1. **Invite Layup**: Treat us like a user in your product.
2. **Contextual Learning**: We analyze and index your product workflows, referencing your KB/documentation for context.
3. **Visual Guides**: Users follow the second cursor and chat overlay step-by-step, reducing friction and confusion.
4. **Zero Maintenance**: The guides update themselves when your UI changes—no more tedious upkeep.

**Get Started**\
Ready to ensure every feature you build gets discovered and adopted?

* **Schedule a time with us**: <https://cal.com/team/layup/founders>
* **Learn more** at <https://layuplabs.ai>.

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Layup saves teams hours creating and maintaining in-product guides and help center content. We transform the way users interact with your products by offering real-time, adaptive assistance via a second cursor that spawns directly in your UI.\
\
**The Problem**\
Users often struggle to discover relevant features or complete the tasks they want, even in products with thoughtfully designed interfaces. They don’t want to look through confusing instructions in a help center or be forced to go through a rigid product tour. \
\
Traditional user adoption platforms like Pendo, Whatfix, and WalkMe are outdated, expensive, and fragile. Product and growth teams invest countless hours tagging and setting up guides, only for them to become obsolete when a UI update is pushed. \
\
It’s a cycle that drains resources and slows down your ability to support users effectively.\
\
**Our Solution**\
With just one line of code, Layup powers a second cursor directly within your product that shows users how to do anything.

Check out our [demo](https://www.loom.com/share/e16cfe3f860441969cfb85a5c5cbd402?sid=1dd5cc59-f98c-4bee-ab38-1eab92764493) here!

**How it Works**

* **Step 1:** Invite Layup as a user to your app and add a single line of code to add Layup’s second cursor/chat widget in your UI.
* **Step 2:** Set up is as easy as inviting Layup as a user to your product. We’ll learn every workflow in your product and tap into your knowledge base / documentation to contextualize them.
* **Step 3:** Your users get tailored guidance instantly with a second cursor that guides them through tasks, new features, or onboarding. Layup’s AI adjusts automatically as your UI changes, ensuring users get uninterrupted support!

**Use Cases**

* **Customer support:** instantly show your users what to do rather than direct them to a help center or support chatbot
* **User onboarding:** reduce the learning curve (and time to value) by visually guiding new users through each step
* **Feature activation:** turn a passive observer into an engaged user by guiding them through the feature in real-time

**Interested in learning more?**

* If you’re interested in deploying Layup, schedule a time with us [**here**](https://cal.com/team/layup)! You can also check out our site at [**https://layuplabs.ai**](https://layuplabs.ai). We’ll work hand in hand with you to support your needs.

launches.title: Layup: AI that puts retention & growth on autopilot
launches.tagline: Layup turns your product usage data into touchpoints that drive retention and growth
launches.body:
### Do things that don’t scale, scalably.

At YC, it’s hammered into us to build what people want. It’s why we spend so much time talking to our earliest users, iterating as we see how they use our product, and understanding what they want next. This hands-on, founder-led motion—aka doing the unscalable—is a key accelerant to scaling. But the reality is - as you grow, you can’t continue to meaningfully engage with every customer. Retention and growth opportunities are left on the table, and both your revenue and roadmap suffer as a result.

\
That’s precisely why we built Layup. To enable you to act on every customer when it matters most. By integrating with your product usage data, Layup enables you to take optimal actions with customers at key points throughout their journey and retain & expand accounts. Layup is the simplest - and only - tool that you need to run and scale your post-sales growth motion.

[Check out our video demo here!](https://www.loom.com/share/2a1398b080334514971cd4c6e099aed7?sid=3fde563d-53dd-463b-b228-3f26597c1450)

* **A single platform for growth and retention**
  * AI that drafts proactive, personalized outreach to your customers to demonstrate recurring value.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81374&key=user_uploads/1126674/3ba6d4bf-e9e4-480b-afb2-8ee313eda81b)

* **Get 100% actively managed account coverage, instantly**
  * Quickly get the insights you need on every customer and take action to expand accounts faster.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81374&key=user_uploads/1126674/a4fef682-d68a-44aa-a644-8c3d8d6ddfeb)

* **Take the right actions every time**
  * See real-time performance data to know what works and refine your actions to meet your goals.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81374&key=user_uploads/1126674/1b7230db-70bc-429a-a925-e05df8ec5dec)

### Featured use cases for early-stage companies (we’ll set these up for you right out of the box!):

* **_Drive adoption:_** reach out at key phases of onboarding to reduce time to value
* **_Reengage users:_** reach dormant users to reduce the risk of churn
* **_Retain and upsell_**: make key touchpoints when plan limit is approaching to drive growth

### How it works

Layup breaks down into two main components:

* **Signals** – surface the best opportunities to take action from your product usage data
* **Playbooks** – drive effortless personalized emails with AI to optimize growth and retention

### Getting onboarded is easy:

1. Bring your product data and CRM into Layup. We will work directly with you to map your usage data to the product signals that you want to track
2. Set up playbooks to automate personalized emails when customers take targeted actions in your product
3. Messages will load directly in your outbox every time a playbook is triggered. Simply review them and hit send

### Our Asks

* Check Layup out! Schedule a demo with us [here](https://meetings.hubspot.com/michael-lemm?uuid=627c0c46-6939-4418-9758-b0124a0ef65d).
* We are actively working with early design partners to further build out our product and have 3 slots left. If you're interested in using Layup for your team and shaping the future of our product, please reach out at [founders@layuplabs.ai](mailto:founders@layuplabs.ai)!

launches.title: Layup: Complete your workflows, with just one line 🏀⚡️
launches.tagline: Turn prompts into workflows across all of your company’s software
launches.body:
Hey YC! [@Mike Lemm](https://www.linkedin.com/in/michael-s-lemm/), [@Badal Jain](https://www.linkedin.com/in/badaljain77/), and [I](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryanxue/) are very excited to launch [Layup](http://www.layupai.com)! ⛹🏾‍♀️⛹🏽⛹🏻‍♂️

# TL;DR

**Layup is every employee’s AI-powered sidekick that builds workflows across all of their company apps.** With just one prompt, it can do things like create an MSA with data from Salesforce, export it to Google Docs, and instantly share it with the right people.

### **The Problem**

Bads, Mike, and I have collectively worked across almost every type of company and have experienced firsthand just how tedious and repetitive it can be to find information and execute workflows across a company's full suite of apps. For example, hiring someone might mean pulling down compensation data from Pave, populating an offer letter in Greenhouse, then setting them up in Rippling when the candidate accepts. Even the most simple daily workflows can involve passing information between 3 and 5 different services.

Layup turns this into a one-shot prompt. We're on a mission to help individuals and organizations streamline their daily tasks with simple prompts so that they can focus on what matters most. We’re moving fast – we now integrate with over 170 applications (and counting!), providing seamless configuration with any company’s knowledge base.

### **How it works**

With one simple prompt – initiate instant, customized workflows to complete your everyday tasks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70272&key=user_uploads/1126674/abcb0ba4-f052-4b6e-92e4-544490863632)

If you have any questions, ideas, or just want to touch base, hit us up! We'd love to hear from you – [founders@layupai.com](mailto:founders@layupai.com)
